fields.description: The Tender BOQ line being contracted. Restricted to the header tender's BOQ rows.
fields.label: Work Item

fields.description: Set on template lines only (no Tender BOQ line). Fixed once the line is created.
fields.label: Work Item Template
BOQ Work Item Template
fields.description: The Work Item Template recorded on this line's Tender BOQ Item (display only; template-mode lines use Work Item Template instead).
1 = Tender line, 0 = template line. Set by the system when the line is created.
fields.label: Follows Tender

fields.description: Total: Unit Price is entered directly. Components: Unit Price is a read-only rollup of this row's priced Material/Labor/Equipment rows.
fields.label: Pricing Mode

fields.description: Deprecated - superseded by the Labor tab (Contractor Contract Labor Item). Retained so pre-existing drafts keep their data.
fields.label: Labor Item (Deprecated)

fields.description: Deprecated - superseded by the Equipment tab (Contractor Contract Equipment Item). Retained so pre-existing drafts keep their data.
fields.label: Equipment Item (Deprecated)

fields.description: Deprecated - superseded by the Labor/Equipment tabs. Retained so pre-existing drafts keep their data.
fields.label: Resource Item (Deprecated)

fields.description: Remaining quantity available to contract, reconciled across all contract types. Only meaningful for Supply and Install - Install Only / Equipment now track availability on their own Labor/Equipment tab rows instead.
fields.label: Available Qty

fields.description: Enterable once Qty is set. Read-only in Components pricing mode - computed from the priced resource rows instead.
fields.label: Unit Price

fields.description: Tender line: Tender direct cost per unit. Template line: the template's cost per unit. Visible to Cost Control and above only.
fields.label: Tender Unit Cost

fields.description: Amount claimed via submitted Contractor Invoices against this line, as a percent of Amount above. Recomputed on Contractor Invoice submit/cancel.
fields.label: Progress %

fields.description: Amount that has reached a submitted Purchase Invoice for this line, as a percent of Amount above - a separate, later gate than Progress % (a Contractor Invoice can be Approved while its generated Purchase Invoice is still working through its own approval workflow). Recomputed on Purchase Invoice submit/cancel.
fields.label: Invoiced %

fields.description: Amount actually paid via submitted Payment Entries against this line's Purchase Invoice(s), as a percent of Amount above - prorated across a Purchase Invoice's own lines by each line's share of that invoice's grand_total when one payment covers several lines. Recomputed on Payment Entry submit/cancel.
fields.label: Paid %

fields.description: Only the 'cost control manager' role may set this, and only once at least one conflicting line is tagged for subcontractor deduction. The conflicting requests are listed in the Material Conflicts section below.
fields.label: Material Conflict Override

fields.description: Whether this work item's Material/Labor/Equipment rows have ever been auto-propagated - kept even after every such row is later deleted, so a further qty edit rescales (or does nothing) instead of re-creating what was deliberately removed.
fields.label: Resources Propagated

fields.description: Set when this line was added by an approved Contract Addendum.
fields.label: Addendum
